# What the definition rewards: exhaustive ground truth and exact gradients for an integrated-information landscape

*Draft — Maxence Faldor. Numbers in this draft are generated by the executed,
committed notebooks in `experiments/` and are exact (oracle-verified where stated).*

## Abstract

Integrated information theory (IIT) assigns to every discrete dynamical system a
quantity φ_s meant to measure how irreducibly its current state constrains its own
causes and effects. Every prior study of the φ landscape has sampled it — by hand
design, by evolution, or by black-box search — because φ was considered
non-differentiable and its exact computation is exponential. We remove both
obstacles at small n: iitx, a JAX implementation verified against the reference
implementation PyPhi to 10⁻⁹ across 36 golden fixtures, computes exact IIT 4.0
quantities with exact almost-everywhere gradients and batches them at ~10⁵
systems/second on a laptop. This enables two firsts. (1) *Exhaustive ground truth*:
we evaluate φ_s for **all 16,777,216 deterministic 3-unit binary systems** (171 s)
and, via a symmetry lemma, for all of their states — the complete landscape of a Φ
measure, no sampling. (2) *Exact gradient ascent on φ_s*, validated against finite
differences at 10⁻¹⁰ relative error. The landscape's verdict is sharp: the true
maximum under the 2023 formalism is exactly 6.0 ibits, attained by 651 equivalence
classes of systems whose analyzed state is a **frozen, self-confirming fixed point
reachable only from itself** — and the construction generalizes, growing as n(n−1),
one ibit per severed connection. The 2026 revision of the theory caps this exploit
to ⟨E02-CAP-PLATEAU⟩, and weighting φ_s by long-run state occupation collapses it to
⟨E02-WEIGHTED-PLATEAU⟩. Gradient ascent beats evolution-style and random baselines
at matched budget but is blind to the frozen plateau, converging instead to interior
"needle" optima that ⟨E02-NEEDLE-VERDICT⟩. Every number reported as φ is exact;
maximizers were re-verified against PyPhi to 10⁻¹⁵.

## 1. Introduction

IIT's structural claims — that integration favors determinism, specialization, and
fault-line-free architectures — have been established from hand-built examples,
exhaustive analysis of a few chosen systems, and evolutionary simulations. The
field's only direct optimization of Φ used prior-guided random search, arguing that
gradients "cannot be extracted" from so discontinuous an objective [Garrido-Merchán
& Sánchez-Cañizares 2022]. Meanwhile the strongest critiques of IIT (Aaronson's
expander construction; the unfolding argument of Doerig et al.) contend that the
*definition* rewards structures the *theory* does not intend.

Both discussions suffer the same evidence problem: nobody has ever seen a Φ
landscape whole. We present the first complete one, and the first exact gradients on
it, and use them to answer: what does the definition actually reward at its maximum,
does the current (2026) revision of the definition change that answer, and can
gradient-based optimization — the only method that scales past enumeration — find
the truth that enumeration establishes?

Three methodological commitments shaped the work, adopted before any result was
known: predictions are pre-registered in each notebook before execution; only exact
values are ever called φ (surrogates are labeled and tracked against exact values at
every step, so a relaxation that climbs while the exact value does not cannot fail
silently); and every striking number is treated as a possible exploit of the
definition until independently verified — the reference implementation, PyPhi,
pinned at a fixed commit, serves as the oracle throughout.

## 2. Instruments

**iitx.** A from-scratch JAX implementation of IIT 4.0 (2023 formalism and the 2026
intrinsic-information-cap variant) and IIT 3.0, for arbitrary finite discrete
systems. All quantities are computed by pure tensor programs (no LP in the 4.0
path), which makes them (a) batchable with `vmap` — the exhaustive sweep runs at
~96,000 exact φ_s evaluations/second on an Apple M2 CPU — and (b) differentiable
almost everywhere, with even-split subgradients at ties. Verification: 36 golden
fixtures generated by pinned PyPhi (IIT 3.0 at 5×10⁻⁶ — the oracle's own EMD
precision — IIT 4.0 exact to 10⁻⁹, including non-binary systems).

**The gradient, audited (experiment e00).** The exact signed φ_s gradient matches
central differences to median relative error 1.4×10⁻¹⁰ (worst of 512 probes:
2.4×10⁻⁸) and is finite at a maximally tie-degenerate symmetric point. This
directly falsifies the claim that Φ gradients cannot be extracted: φ_s is piecewise
smooth — a min/max over *enumerated* discrete selections — and Danskin's theorem
does the rest. The audit also quantified the softmin surrogate `soft_system_phi`:
its bias plateaus at ≈0.06 ibits for temperatures τ ≥ 0.03 and only vanishes below
τ ≈ 0.01, and an annealed schedule (τ: 0.5 → 0.005) decisively beats both fixed-τ
smoothing and raw subgradient ascent (median endpoint 2.36 vs 0.98 ibits over 256
matched seeds). Annealed ascent is used everywhere below; exact φ_s is evaluated
alongside at every step.

**The fixed-state lemma.** The group G = S_n × {0,1}ⁿ (unit permutations and
per-unit relabelings, |G| = 48 at n = 3) acts on systems by conjugation with
φ_s(g·f, g(s)) = φ_s(f, s), and its bit-flip subgroup acts transitively on states.
Consequently a sweep of *all systems at one fixed state* implicitly contains
φ_s(f, s) for *every* system and state — retrievable by a vectorized conjugation
lookup — and the quotient by G yields the complete atlas of equivalence classes.
The invariance and the lookup identity are asserted numerically in the notebooks
before use.

## 3. The atlas (experiment e01)

All (2⁸)³ = 16,777,216 deterministic 3-unit systems were evaluated exactly at the
all-off state (171 s) and canonicalized under G (19 s) into **352,744 equivalence
classes**.

**Integration is rare.** 84.1% of systems are reducible (φ_s = 0) at the analyzed
state; 40.2% of classes have no member above zero there; the median class tops out
at 0.415 ibits; the 99th percentile is 2.0.

**The maximum is exactly 6.0 ibits**, attained by 3,591 systems in 651 classes and
confirmed against PyPhi to 9×10⁻¹⁶. For calibration: the all-XOR loop scores 1.5,
the strongest published hand-built 3-unit example 2.0, and single-seed gradient
ascent 2.34.

**The maximizer is a frozen, self-confirming state.** In the winning systems the
analyzed state is a fixed point whose *only preimage is itself* (in-degree 1);
several states are Garden-of-Eden, and all other trajectories drain into a different
attractor. φ_s at the seven other states of the exemplar winner: six zeros and one
0.2075. The mechanism is elementary once seen. Cause side: nothing else maps to the
state, so retrodiction is a delta function and cause informativeness saturates.
Effect side: determinism makes prediction a delta. Every cut destroys both
completely. Maximal integrated information, under the 2023 definition, describes a
state the system can occupy only by starting there and never leaving — perfect
self-retrodiction and self-prediction of an isolated stationary point.

**The spectrum is gapped.** No deterministic class scores between 4.885 and 6.0.
The frozen plateau is not the top of a continuum; it is separated from the rest of
the landscape.

**Gradient ascent is blind to it.** Annealed ascent from 10,240 seeds (6.1M gradient
evaluations) beat a hill climber and random search at identical budget (best 4.885
vs 4.685 vs 0.555) — but **zero** seeds reached any of the 651 maximal classes, and
endpoints occupied just 183 classes in total. Snapping endpoints to their nearest
deterministic vertex *loses* φ_s for 70% of seeds: the relaxed landscape's peaks are
interior needles, not vertex approaches.

## 4. Does the exploit survive? (experiment e02)

⟨E02-SECTION: 2026 sweep results, weighted-atlas results, n(n−1) table for
n = 3..6, needle forensics, 2026-objective ascent.⟩

Known before e02 ran (measured in a design probe, declared as such in the
notebook): the e01 winner scores φ_s = 0.0 under the 2026 cap and big Φ = 0.335
under IIT 3.0; the all-OR system realizes the frozen-isolation construction
analytically and attains 6.0 at n = 3 and 12.0 at n = 4 — refuting our own initial
"information ceiling 2·log₂ Q" reading of the 6.0 result (a coincidence at n = 3)
in favor of φ_s = n(n−1): one ibit per connection severed by the complete cut,
quadratic growth through frozen isolation.

## 5. Discussion

⟨E02-DEPENDENT: finalize after e02 — the 2026-vindication claim, the
reachability-weighted maximizers, and what ascent's needles are.⟩

Three points stand independent of e02's specifics.

**Ground truth changes the epistemics.** Claims about "what maximizes Φ" have until
now rested on examples. At n = 3 they can rest on enumeration: every deterministic
system, every state, every symmetry class. The atlas is small (67 MB) and regenerable
in minutes; any proposed revision of the measure can be re-scored against the entire
universe at the cost of one sweep.

**The definition-vs-intention gap is now measurable.** The frozen-state maximizer is
a theorem-grade instance of the pattern Aaronson's critique alleged by construction:
the definition's optimum is a structure the theory's own proponents would not call
richly conscious. Whether a revision closes the gap is an empirical question the
atlas answers mechanically — which is exactly how we test the 2026 cap.

**Gradients are the scalable instrument, with a known blind spot.** Exact ascent
beats matched-budget gradient-free search but cannot see isolated plateaus whose
basins require passing through reducibility. At n = 3 enumeration wins by
definition; at n = 6 (where exact φ_s costs 0.5 s and its gradient 1.1 s) only
gradients remain. Knowing precisely what they miss at n = 3 — frozen isolation — is
what makes them trustworthy above it.

**Limitations.** Ground truth is deterministic-only (stochastic systems are covered
by ascent, not enumeration); the parameterization is conditionally independent
units; n = 3 is small, though it is the scale at which the published counter-example
literature lives; and φ_s is one measure of one theory version — the measure-generic
machinery of iitx exists precisely to widen this.

## 6. Reproducibility

iitx 0.1.0 (`pip install iitx`), Python 3.14, JAX 0.11.1, float64 on CPU (Apple
M2). Oracle: PyPhi `main` @ ce2b2832, pinned in `tests/oracle/generate`. All
experiments are executed, committed notebooks under `experiments/` with
pre-registered predictions in the first cell and verdicts in the last: e00
(gradient audit), e01 (atlas), e02 (exploit survival). Runtimes: full sweep 171 s;
canonicalization 19 s; 10,240-seed ascent 89 s; each baseline ~65 s.
